description: Remove a mailbox (soft delete). Required: mailbox_id. By DEFAULT the already-fetched mails are KEPT and stay readable via list_emails/get_email — they belong to the tenant, not to the connection they arrived through; their triage state and links to leads and drafts stay. The mailbox is marked removed and no longer syncs or appears in list_mailboxes. The answer reports kept_emails. Pass delete_emails=true to ALSO delete every already-fetched mail of this mailbox (irreversible) — only then is anything deleted. Refuses while the mailbox is the default sender unless force=true, because removing it silently sends the next unmatched mail through the shared address.

delete_emails.description: Also delete all fetched mails of this mailbox (irreversible)

force.description: Remove even if the mailbox is the default sender

mailbox_id.description: ID of the mailbox to delete

name: delete_mailbox
